setup-worktree-unix: git -C "$ROOT_WORKTREE_PATH" ls-files -o -i --exclude-from=.worktreeinclude -z | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do test -f "$ROOT_WORKTREE_PATH/$f" && mkdir -p "$(dirname "$f")" && cp "$ROOT_WORKTREE_PATH/$f" "$f" || true; done
echo 'mesita: seeded from .worktreeinclude; before the first write claim this worktree: deno task worktree add MESITA-<id> <slug> --adopt . (Rules I-3)'
